AudioFormat.description: Loosely describe audio format. Some values (e.g., 'wav') denote containers; others (e.g., 'linear16') specify encoding only; cannot describe containers that can contain different audio encodings.

PartDelta.description: Delta parts used in partial updates.

Message.description: A message in an LLM conversation history.

Modality.description: Defines the modality of content (e.g., text or audio) in LLM responses.

ToolResultStatus.description: The terminal status of a tool call.

ToolChoiceOption.description:
Determines how the model should choose which tool to use:
- "auto": The model will automatically choose the tool to use or not use any tools.
- "none": The model will not use any tools.
- "required": The model will be forced to use a tool.
- { type: "tool", toolName: "toolName" }: The model will use the specified tool.

ResponseFormatOption.description: The format that the model must output.

LanguageModelCapabilities.description: The capabilities supported by the model.

TextPart.description: A part of the message that contains text.

signature.description: An opaque provider signature used to preserve text-part continuity when returning the part to the same provider.

ImagePart.description: A part of the message that contains an image.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the image. E.g. "image/jpeg", "image/png".

data.description: The base64-encoded image data. Either `data` or `url` must be provided.

url.description: A URL the media can be fetched from. Providers that cannot fetch URLs for this part reject it; pass `data` instead.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

id.description: ID of the image part, if applicable

AudioPart.description: A part of the message that contains an audio.

data.description: The base64-encoded audio data. Either `data` or `url` must be provided.

url.description: A URL the media can be fetched from. Providers that cannot fetch URLs for this part reject it; pass `data` instead.

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the audio. E.g. 44100, 48000.

channels.description: The number of channels of the audio. E.g. 1, 2.

id.description: ID of the audio part, if applicable

SourcePart.description:
A part of the message that contains a source with structured content.
It will be used for citation for supported models.

source.description: The URL or identifier of the document.

ToolCallPart.description: A part of the message that represents a call to a tool the model wants to use.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call, used to match the tool result with the tool call.

id.description: The ID of the tool call part, if applicable. This is different from tool_call_id which is used to match tool results.

signature.description: The provider-specific signature used to preserve reasoning/tool continuity.

ToolCall.description: The provider-independent payload of a tool invocation.

ToolResultPart.description: A part of the message that represents the result of a tool call.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call from previous assistant message.

ToolResult.description: The provider-independent payload of a tool result.

signature.description: Opaque provider data required to replay this source to the same provider.

error_code.description: Provider error code required to replay a failed hosted-search result.

ReasoningPart.description: A part of the message that represents the model reasoning.

id.description: The ID of the reasoning part, if applicable

Citation.description: Represents a citation for a part.

source.description: The URL or identifier of the document being cited.

title.description: The title of the document being cited.

cited_text.description: The text snippet from the document being cited.

start_index.description: The start index of the document content part being cited.

end_index.description: The end index of the document content part being cited.

signature.description: An opaque provider signature used to preserve citation continuity when returning it to the same provider.

UserMessage.description: Represents a message sent by the user.

AssistantMessage.description: Represents a message generated by the model.

ToolMessage.description:
Represents tool result in the message history.
Only ToolResultPart should be included in the content.

TextPartDelta.description: A delta update for a text part, used in streaming or incremental updates of a message.

signature.description: An opaque provider signature used to preserve text-part continuity when returning the part to the same provider.

CitationDelta.description: A delta update for a citation part, used in streaming of citation messages.

source.description: The URL or identifier of the document being cited.

title.description: The title of the document being cited.

cited_text.description: The text snippet from the document being cited.

start_index.description: The start index of the document content part being cited.

end_index.description: The end index of the document content part being cited.

signature.description: An opaque provider signature used to preserve citation continuity when returning it to the same provider.

ToolCallPartDelta.description: A delta update for a tool call part, used in streaming of a tool invocation.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call, used to match the tool result with the tool call.

id.description: The ID of the tool call part, if applicable. This is different from tool_call_id which is used to match tool results.

signature.description: The provider-specific signature used to preserve reasoning/tool continuity.

ToolResultPartDelta.description: An atomic delta containing a hosted or client tool result.

ImagePartDelta.description: A delta update for an image part, used in streaming of an image message.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the image. E.g. "image/jpeg", "image/png".

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

id.description: ID of the image part, if applicable

AudioPartDelta.description: A delta update for an audio part, used in streaming of an audio message.

format.description: Loosely describe audio format. Some values (e.g., 'wav') denote containers; others (e.g., 'linear16') specify encoding only; cannot describe containers that can contain different audio encodings.

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the audio. E.g. 44100, 48000.

channels.description: The number of channels of the audio. E.g. 1, 2.

id.description: The ID of the audio part, if applicable

ReasoningPartDelta.description: A delta update for a reasoning part, used in streaming of reasoning messages.

id.description: The ID of the reasoning part, if applicable

ContentDelta.description: Represents a delta update in a message's content, enabling partial streaming updates in LLM responses.

Tool.description: Represents a tool that can be used by the model.

FunctionTool.description: Represents a client-executed function tool that can be used by the model.

parameters.description: The JSON schema of the parameters that the tool accepts. The type must be "object".

defer_loading.description: Hide the tool from the model until a `tool_search` tool discovers it. Providers without tool search ignore this flag and load the tool eagerly.

WebSearchTool.description: Represents a provider-hosted web search tool.

allowed_domains.description: Restricts search results to these domains when supported by the provider.

max_uses.description: Limits the number of searches the provider may perform when supported.

WebSearchUserLocation.description: An approximate user location used to localize web search results.

region.description: The region or state of the user.

country.description: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code of the user.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone of the user.

cached_tokens.description: The tokens read from the prompt cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: The tokens written to the prompt cache.

extended_cache_write_tokens.description: The subset of `cache_write_tokens` stored with extended retention (see `cache_retention`), which some providers bill at a higher rate.

ModelTokensDetails.description: A breakdown of `input_tokens` or `output_tokens`, using the provider's own counting.

ModelUsage.description: Represents the token usage of the model.

input_tokens.description: The input tokens as reported by the provider. Whether cached and cache-write tokens are included depends on the provider.

output_tokens.description: The output tokens as reported by the provider. Whether reasoning tokens are included depends on the provider.

ModelResponse.description: Represents the response generated by the model.

PartialModelResponse.description: Represents a partial response from the language model, useful for streaming output via async generator.

ToolChoiceAuto.description: The model will automatically choose the tool to use or not use any tools.

ToolChoiceNone.description: The model will not use any tools.

ToolChoiceRequired.description: The model will be forced to use a tool.

ToolChoiceTool.description: The model will use the specified tool.

tool_name.description: The model will use the specified tool.

ResponseFormatText.description: Specifies that the model response should be in plain text format.

ResponseFormatJson.description: Specifies that the model response should be in JSON format adhering to a specified schema.

voice.description: The provider-specific voice ID to use for audio generation.

language.description: The language code for the audio generation.

budget_tokens.description: Specify the budget tokens for reasoning generation.

LanguageModelInput.description: Defines the input parameters for the language model completion.

system_prompt.description: A system prompt is a way of providing context and instructions to the model

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

tools.description: Definitions of tools that the model may use.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.

temperature.description: Amount of randomness injected into the response. Ranges from 0.0 to 1.0

top_p.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. Ranges from 0.0 to 1.0

top_k.description: Only sample from the top K options for each subsequent token. Used to remove 'long tail' low probability responses. Must be a non-negative integer.

presence_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

frequency_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

seed.description: The seed (integer), if set and supported by the model, to enable deterministic results.

modalities.description: The modalities that the model should support.

cache_retention.description: Opts into the provider's prompt cache and chooses how long entries are kept. "standard" uses the provider's default retention and "extended" the longest it offers. Providers without a retention setting ignore this option.

metadata.description: A set of key/value pairs that store additional information about the request. This is forwarded to the model provider if supported.

LanguageModelPricing.description: A metadata property that describes the pricing of the model.

input_cost_per_text_token.description: The cost in USD per single text token for input.

input_cost_per_cached_token.description: The cost in USD per single cached input token.

input_cost_per_cache_write_token.description: The cost in USD per single cache-write input token.

input_cost_per_extended_cache_write_toke.description: The cost in USD per single cache-write input token stored with extended retention. Defaults to `input_cost_per_cache_write_token`.

input_cost_per_cached_text_token.description: The cost in USD per single cached text token for input.

output_cost_per_text_token.description: The cost in USD per single text token for output.

input_cost_per_audio_token.description: The cost in USD per single audio token for input.

input_cost_per_cached_audio_token.description: The cost in USD per single cached audio token for input.

output_cost_per_audio_token.description: The cost in USD per single audio token for output.

input_cost_per_image_token.description: The cost in USD per single image token for input.

input_cost_per_cached_image_token.description: The cost in USD per single cached image token for input.

output_cost_per_image_token.description: The cost in USD per single image token for output.

cost_per_web_search_request.description: The cost in USD per provider-hosted web search request.

long_context.description: Rate multipliers applied to requests whose input exceeds a token threshold.

FilePart.description: Document or video input; accepted MIME types depend on the model.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the file. E.g. "application/pdf", "text/plain", "video/mp4".

data.description: The file contents in the format accepted by the model. Either `data` or `url` must be provided.

url.description: A URL the file can be fetched from. Providers that cannot fetch URLs for this part reject it; pass `data` instead.

filename.description: The file name, forwarded to providers that display or require it.

ToolSearchToolCall.description: A provider-hosted search over the deferred tools of the request.

args.description: The provider-native search arguments, e.g. { "query": "weather" }, { "pattern": "weather|forecast" }, or { "paths": ["get_weather"] }.

ToolSearchToolResult.description: Discovered tools made available to the model.

tool_names.description: Discovered tool names; each must be declared in the request's `tools`.

error_code.description: Provider error code required to replay a failed hosted tool search.

args.description: The partial JSON string of the search arguments.

ToolSearchTool.description: Loads deferred function tools on demand through hosted search.

strategy.description: The search algorithm, when the provider offers a choice. Defaults to "bm25".

ModelServerToolUsage.description: Hosted tool usage billed per request, separately from tokens.

LanguageModelLongContextPricing.description: Rate multipliers applied to requests whose input exceeds a token threshold.

threshold_tokens.description: The request is priced with the multipliers when `input_tokens` exceeds this value.

input_cost_multiplier.description: The multiplier applied to every input rate. Defaults to 1.

output_cost_multiplier.description: The multiplier applied to every output rate. Defaults to 1.

CacheRetention.description: How long prompt cache entries are kept.
